description: This file contains unit tests for the UserService class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically testing user management functionalities such as saving users, password verification, and retrieving user credentials.

classes.name: UserServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for verifying the functionality of UserService, including saving users, password verification, credential retrieval, and handling undeletable user IDs.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the UserService instance before each test.

methods.name: getUserRole
methods.description: Helper method to create a UserRole object with ID 1 and name 'Admin'.

methods.name: testSaveSystemUserNoPasswordChange
methods.description: Tests saving a user without changing the password; expects the user to be saved as is.

methods.name: testSaveSystemUserWithPasswordChange
methods.description: Tests saving a user when the password is changed, verifying that the password is hashed before saving.

methods.name: testIsCurrentPasswordUserNotFound
methods.description: Checks that the function returns false when the user is not found in the database.

methods.name: testIsCurrentPasswordTrue
methods.description: Verifies that the current password check succeeds with a correct password.

methods.name: testIsCurrentPasswordWithNullPassword
methods.description: Tests behavior when the stored password is null; expects false.

methods.name: testIsCurrentPasswordOldHash
methods.description: Checks that an old MD5 hash passwords can be verified as correct.

methods.name: testIsCurrentPasswordFalse
methods.description: Verifies that an incorrect password results in a false response.

methods.name: testGetCredentialsUserNotFound
methods.description: Ensures that null is returned when no user exists with provided credentials.

methods.name: testGetCredentialsValidPassword
methods.description: Tests successful credential verification with correct password and verifying that the user object is returned.

methods.name: testGetCredentialsOldHash
methods.description: Tests migrating an old MD5 hashed password to a proper hash during credential verification.

methods.name: testGetCredentialsInvalidPassword
methods.description: Verifies that credential verification fails with an invalid password.

methods.name: testGetUndeletableUserIds
methods.description: Tests retrieval of user IDs that cannot be deleted based on user roles.
